verdict.rationale: PayPal's Disputes API and Resolution Center let finance-ops view, respond to, and automate dispute handling, which covers the core ability to submit evidence and monitor dispute status (paypal-docs-6,7,25,26). However, the docs are high-level marketing descriptions with no detail on structured evidence fields, dispute lifecycle stages, or SLA/timelines, and community reports (unrelated to the mechanics) don't dispute the tooling itself. Missing for 10: detailed evidence schema/field documentation, explicit lifecycle-stage tracking API reference, and independent hands-on confirmation that evidence submission via API works as described.
